name: mstack-brainstorm
description: Turn an unformed idea into a design brief the user approved: reads before asking, asks one open question at a time until the reason is known, then numbered rounds, lays out whole-shape approaches, generates ideas before judging them in ideas mode, and hands the approved brief to mstack-write-specs. One skill for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Turn an unformed idea into an approved design brief.
interface.longDescription: Finds out what the user wants and why before anything is built: reads the repository first, asks open questions until the reason is known and numbered rounds after, lays out whole-shape approaches, offers ideas mode, and writes a design brief the user approves, ready for mstack-write-specs.
